summary_md:
# Anthropic leverede varen - men nervøsiteten hersker i markedet

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode of Euroinvestor's Millionærklubben, a Danish podcast, covers the market's nervous mood after Anthropic's record IPO, which rose about 35% at the open but fell back during the day. The same day Nasdaq dropped 2.25% and Asian markets sold off hard, driven by uncertainty over AI-infrastructure growth and valuations after 2028. Michael Friis Jørgensen (H.C. Andersen Capital) is buying NKT again, plans to start buying Alibaba around 80, and owns Tesla only for a possible merger premium from SpaceX. Laura Svendsen (Svendsen & Tudborg) stays positive on big tankers such as Frontline, Torm and Capital Tankers for the next two years and expects an oversupply of new ships after that.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Michael is buying again (started at 830 DKK) at just under 800. Laura calls it a sensible five-year investment.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael Friis Jørgensen: the EUR 900m+ EBITDA target for 2030 implies a P/E of about 11-12 if NKT executes. He sold at 1100-1200 and now calls it 'absolutely worth buying'. Support comes from the record orderbook, the Karlskrona plant starting Q2 2027 and the electrification trend. Laura agrees but stresses a long holding period.

#### Sell Triggers

- if execution of the orderbook or the capex programme slips
- if 2030 EBITDA targets are cut
- if the AI-infrastructure selloff deepens

> *"Nu er det absolut købsværdigt igen."*

---

### 🟡 FRO — Frontline | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Laura is positive: USD 641m profit, full payout as dividend, Q4 rates even better. Target NOK 600 (USD 60).

#### Reasoning

Guest Laura Svendsen owns it. Very large crude tankers earn up to USD 500k per day against a cash breakeven of about USD 28k. She expects good times for two years and then a flood of newbuilds, so she is holding for her target rather than adding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a wave of newbuild deliveries arrives (in about 2 years)
- if tanker rates collapse
- if the shadow fleet returns to normal trade

> *"Jamen, jeg sidder jo og siger, at den skal i 600 norske, eller 60 dollar."*

---

### 🟡 TRMD-A — Torm | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Laura owns it. Hafnia's share distribution weighs on the price, but at 215 versus about 275 in value another bidder could appear.

#### Reasoning

Guest Laura Svendsen: Hafnia gave up the takeover and will hand its Torm shares out to its own shareholders, which creates selling pressure. The stock trades cheaply against its ship value, and a cash-rich player such as TK Tankers could buy the 20% stake.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Hafnia's distributed shares flood the market
- if the tanker cycle turns after 2 years

> *"Det er jo ikke så dårligt, hvis du køber 215."*

---

### 🟢 BABA — Alibaba | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Michael will make his first buy around 80. Reasons: own chips, the end of the food-delivery price war and a P/E of 10.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael Friis Jørgensen: down 43% this year. China is building its own chips and Alibaba could become the dominant AI hyperscaler in Asia, like Alphabet. Ending the food-delivery price war should lift earnings. Results in 2027 may be weaker in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the chip shortage hits results hard
- if the food-delivery competition comes back

> *"her ved 80, der kommer du til at se mig lægge noget ind i Mellemærklubben"*

---

### 🟠 TSLA — Tesla | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Too expensive, but Michael might buy for the first time on an expected merger premium from SpaceX within six months.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael Friis Jørgensen: robotaxis are the real case but face competition (Waymo) and the stock is overvalued. He is 85% sure of a SpaceX merger before Trump loses power, which would give Tesla shareholders a premium. He also said he would never buy at this price, so the view is mixed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the SpaceX merger does not happen
- if SpaceX loses value

> *"den er jeg 85% sikker på, at den bliver trykket inden for et halvt år"*

---

### 🟡 CARL-B — Carlsberg | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael sees room to rise in both brewers. Carlsberg is safer: strong balance sheet, diversified after Britvic.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael Friis Jørgensen: Royal Unibrew has more upside only if the CEO replaces Pepsi and handles input costs. Carlsberg is the calmer choice, so there is no strong case for switching.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the beer market weakens

> *"Jamen, jeg tror begge har mere plads at løbe på."*

---

### ⛔ ANTHROPIC — Anthropic | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael flipped his IPO allotment at the open (+35%) and says he will not own it.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael Friis Jørgensen took part only because the IPO was oversubscribed and synthetic ETFs pointed to a jump. He sold at the open and has no wish to own it long term. No private ticker is known, so 'ANTHROPIC' is a placeholder.

> *"Jeg har en, og jeg skal ikke eje den"*

---
